email_body:
Dear Schneider Electric Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing and Communication Internship. As a digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web, I'm eager to bring my skills to your team and learn from marketing professionals.

In my current roles, I support marketing campaigns through keyword research, on-page SEO, and content creation for client websites. I've built and optimized sites in WordPress, managed CMS content, and used analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance. I also have a technical background, which helps me understand how marketing strategies come to life online.

I'm organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—qualities I apply daily when juggling multiple client projects. I thrive in collaborative settings and am excited about the opportunity to contribute to real campaigns while growing my marketing expertise.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Schneider Electric Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Marketing and Communication Internship. With a strong passion for marketing and a growing skill set in digital marketing, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team and learn from experienced professionals.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I have gained practical experience in SEO, content creation, and website management. I have supported marketing campaigns by conducting keyword research, optimizing on-page content, and tracking performance using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. I have also managed CMS content for client websites, ensuring that communication materials are clear and aligned with target audiences. For example, I built and optimized a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical audits that measurably improved search health. This hands-on work has taught me how to turn marketing strategies into tangible results.

What draws me to Schneider Electric is your commitment to sustainability and innovation, values that resonate with my own interest in using digital tools to create meaningful impact. I am eager to bring my organizational skills, attention to detail, and collaborative mindset to your marketing team. I thrive in fast-paced environments where I can juggle multiple tasks and meet deadlines, and I am always proactive in finding solutions.

I am confident that my mix of technical and marketing skills, along with my desire to learn, makes me a strong candidate for this internship. I am excited about the prospect of contributing to real campaigns and gaining insight into the full marketing process.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
